# API reference

<!-- Generated by go run ./tools/apidoc; do not edit by hand. -->

This reference lists all 93 HTTP routes registered by the master when every built-in plugin is enabled. Every route explicitly declares its required permission level:

- **Public**: callable without authentication.
- **Signed in**: requires a valid Bearer session token in the `Authorization` header.
- **Machine (mTLS)**: callable by a cluster slave or Web Access Gateway presenting a verified client certificate; served only on the sync endpoint.
- **`object:action`**: requires at least one assigned role that grants the specified policy permission (see [Identity & Access Layer](layer-access.md)).

All responses are JSON: `{"data": …}` on success, and `{"error": {"code", "message", "requestId"}}` on failure.

## Core

Health checks and the session capability map that drives the web navigation menu.

| Method | Path | Permission | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/api/v2/me/access` | Signed in | Return the signed-in user's enabled plugins and granted permissions for building the UI navigation menu. |
| `GET` | `/healthz` | Public | Liveness check; also served on the sync endpoint. |

## Sign-in and passwords

Package `internal/domain/auth`. Password login, token refresh and revocation, password changes, and email verification codes.

| Method | Path | Permission | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `POST` | `/api/v2/auth/login` | Public | Authenticate with username and password and issue a session token (HTTPS required). |
| `POST` | `/api/v2/auth/logout` | Signed in | Revoke the caller's current session token. |
| `GET` | `/api/v2/auth/password-reset` | Public | Check whether self-service email password reset is enabled. |
| `POST` | `/api/v2/auth/password-reset/confirm` | Public | Reset an account's password using a valid 6-digit email verification code. |
| `POST` | `/api/v2/auth/password-reset/request` | Public | Send a 6-digit password reset code to the account matching the username or email address. |
| `POST` | `/api/v2/auth/refresh` | Signed in | Exchange the current session token for a new one and revoke the old token ID. |
| `PUT` | `/api/v2/me/password` | Signed in | Update the signed-in user's password using their current password or an emailed verification code. |
| `POST` | `/api/v2/me/password/code` | Signed in | Send a password-change verification code to the signed-in user's email address. |
| `GET` | `/api/v2/password-mail/config` | `notification:read` | Retrieve the password verification email configuration and template. |
| `PUT` | `/api/v2/password-mail/config` | `notification:update` | Update the password verification email configuration and template. |
| `POST` | `/api/v2/password-mail/preview` | `notification:read` | Render the password verification email template with sample variables. |
| `GET` | `/api/v2/password-mail/sample` | `notification:read` | Return sample payload data and allowed template variables for password verification emails. |
| `POST` | `/api/v2/password-mail/test` | `notification:update` | Send a test password verification email through the configured provider. |

## Users, groups and roles

Package `internal/domain/identity`. Every mutation enforces rank-based anti-escalation checks.

| Method | Path | Permission | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/api/v2/groups` | `group:read` | List all POSIX groups and organizational units. |
| `POST` | `/api/v2/groups` | `group:create` | Create a group; POSIX groups receive a GID and optional home directory / shell presets. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/v2/groups/{id}` | `group:delete` | Delete a group. |
| `GET` | `/api/v2/groups/{id}` | `group:read` | Retrieve a group's details and member list. |
| `PATCH` | `/api/v2/groups/{id}` | `group:update` | Update a group's description, home root, or login shell preset. |
| `POST` | `/api/v2/groups/{id}/members` | `group:update` | Atomically add and remove group members in a single batch. |
| `GET` | `/api/v2/me` | Signed in | Return the signed-in user's profile and group memberships. |
| `PUT` | `/api/v2/me/shell` | Signed in | Update the signed-in user's default login shell. |
| `GET` | `/api/v2/roles` | `role:read` | List all RBAC roles ordered by rank. |
| `POST` | `/api/v2/roles` | `role:create` | Create a new role ranked strictly below the caller's best rank. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/v2/roles/{id}` | `role:delete` | Delete a role ranked below the caller. |
| `PATCH` | `/api/v2/roles/{id}` | `role:update` | Update a role ranked below the caller. |
| `GET` | `/api/v2/roles/{id}/permissions` | `role:read` | List the `(object, action)` permission grants assigned to a role. |
| `PUT` | `/api/v2/roles/{id}/permissions` | `role:update` | Replace a role's permissions (callers may only grant permissions they hold themselves). |
| `GET` | `/api/v2/users` | `user:read` | List users with optional search, status, and group filters. |
| `POST` | `/api/v2/users` | `user:create` | Create a user account with a POSIX UID, primary POSIX group, supplementary groups, and roles. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/v2/users/{id}` | `user:delete` | Delete a user ranked lower than the caller and revoke their active certificates. |
| `GET` | `/api/v2/users/{id}` | `user:read` | Retrieve a single user's profile, groups, and roles. |
| `PATCH` | `/api/v2/users/{id}` | `user:update` | Update a user account ranked lower than the caller. |
| `POST` | `/api/v2/users/{id}/password-reset` | `user:update` | Generate a temporary random password for a user and return it once. |
| `PUT` | `/api/v2/users/{id}/status` | `user:update` | Enable or disable a user account; disabling automatically revokes active certificates. |

## Certificates

Package `internal/domain/pki`. Manages SSH and X.509 CAs, user certificates, and revocations. CA private keys never leave the master.

| Method | Path | Permission | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/api/v2/me/certificate` | Signed in | Retrieve metadata for the signed-in user's active certificate. |
| `POST` | `/api/v2/me/certificate` | Signed in | Issue a new certificate and private key for the signed-in user (private key returned once). |
| `GET` | `/api/v2/pki/cas` | `pki:read` | List Certificate Authorities (private keys are never returned). |
| `POST` | `/api/v2/pki/cas` | `pki:create` | Generate or import an SSH or X.509 CA; seals the private key with `PKI_MASTER_KEY`. |
| `POST` | `/api/v2/pki/cas/{id}/revocations` | `pki:delete` | Revoke a certificate serial number under the specified CA. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/v2/users/{id}/certificate` | `pki:delete` | Revoke a user's active certificate. |
| `POST` | `/api/v2/users/{id}/certificate` | `pki:create` | Issue an initial certificate for a user under a chosen CA. |
| `POST` | `/api/v2/users/{id}/certificate/rotate` | `pki:update` | Rotate a user's certificate and revoke the superseded serial. |

## Audit

Package `internal/audit`. Queries and verifies the SHA-256 hash-chained audit trail.

| Method | Path | Permission | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/api/v2/audit` | `audit:read` | List audit log records with pagination and filtering. |
| `GET` | `/api/v2/audit/verify` | `audit:read` | Verify the SHA-256 audit hash chain and report the first tampered or broken record, if any. |

## Mail hub

Package `internal/mail`. Configures named email providers and tracks delivery metrics.

| Method | Path | Permission | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/api/v2/mail/kinds` | `mail:read` | List mail provider drivers compiled into this build (`smtp`, `rest`, `pool`). |
| `GET` | `/api/v2/mail/providers` | `mail:read` | List configured mail providers (secrets are redacted). |
| `DELETE` | `/api/v2/mail/providers/{name}` | `mail:update` | Delete a mail provider. |
| `PUT` | `/api/v2/mail/providers/{name}` | `mail:update` | Create or update a mail provider and seal its credentials. |
| `POST` | `/api/v2/mail/providers/{name}/test` | `mail:update` | Send a test email through the specified provider. |
| `GET` | `/api/v2/mail/usage` | `mail:read` | Query daily email delivery counts broken down by provider and purpose. |

## Cluster sync

Package `internal/replication`. Machine-authenticated endpoints served exclusively on the sync host.

| Method | Path | Permission | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/sync/v2/snapshot` | Machine (mTLS) | Download the full identity and trust snapshot (`X-Data-Hash` carries its SHA-256 digest). |
| `GET` | `/sync/v2/snapshot-hash` | Machine (mTLS) | Return only the current snapshot SHA-256 digest for deployments that do not use DNS TXT polling. |
